summary: Battalion Oil Corp's subsidiary entered a Third Amended and Restated Senior Secured Credit Agreement on June 30, 2026, refinancing existing debt. The deal provides a $162.5M term loan funded at close and a discretionary $175M delayed draw facility maturing Dec 31, 2029. Interest is SOFR-based plus credit spread. No acquisition, divestiture, or shareholder return; it is a routine refinancing of secured credit facilities. Watch for future draws under delayed facility and covenant compliance.
